notes.title: Hunting Modes Update
notes.notes:
https://imgur.com/gJwu9l0.gif
Hey Hunters,
A variety of Hunting Modes have been added to Duck Season along with several other improvements and Valve Index compatibility!

New hunting modes are chosen at random during certain game hours or can be chosen in the Practice scene.  Hunting modes provide some new challenges to hunting ducks.

Many additional optimizations have been implemented.

Lighting optimizations.

Valve Index compatibility.

Variety of minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Duck Season launches a cheaper but still spooky non-VR version
notes.notes:
I’ve always wanted to play Duck Season. I’ve heard it described as the Pony Island of virtual reality – a cute VR Duck Hunt clone that unfurls into something far more sinister. Unfortunately, due to my lack of future-tech headgear I’ve not had the chance to play it. Duck Season PC is a version of the game re-worked by Stress Level Zero for the mouse and keyboard crowd, and it launched today. While I can’t see it being quite as intense a ride stripped of some of its more immersive elements, I’m still glad to see this version out, and at budget price. See the launch trailer below.

notes.title: Halloween Patch 10/27/17
notes.notes:
https://i.imgur.com/wMNarxq.gif
We're glad that everyone is enjoying Duck Season!  We whipped up a short Halloween easter egg scene accessed via the Kid Wizard book after your first play through has been completed.  Also, numerous bug fixes and tweaks are detailed in the patch notes below.

***Warning patch note contain spoilers***

Added Pumpkins
Added Halloween easter egg scene
Added Final Fiesta cutscene ending clue
Added support for Hyperkin Blaster controller
Added spooky achievement


Adjusted chance of gold shell spawning - reflects ending progress more accurately
Adjusted completion time for best men ending to get trophy
Adjusted adaptive sampling settings (should fix certain Oculus+AMD flicker issues)
Adjusted midnight timing
Adjusted resolution override, should fix low resolution issues
Adjusted some sound effect levels
Adjusted title menu wording


Fixed controller input switching when left/right hand switches
Fixed controller bugs when controllers are turned on/off 
Fixed kid wizard book particles
Fixed shotgun in showcase scene
Automatically hide hand when controller is disconnected
